proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: an automorphism of xi = (T, h, L, alpha) is multiplication by a global unit u of O_{X_T} with sigma_T^*u = 1; u = 1 by the pushforward assumption, so the stack is fibred in setoids; the isomorphism classes of pairs (L, alpha) are the classes of L with sigma_T^*L = O_T, since two choices of alpha differ by a global unit on T, which is the same as a global unit on X_T by the pushforward assumption (source lines 3203-3220)
